course.title: Surveying and Cartography
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A ground is developed by maintaining a fairly uniform level. A survey team is requested to check the desired level of the improved ground. During checking process they noticed that along a survey line with zero slope the level machine is providing different staff readings. What is the reason behind this situation? What kind of error is it? Derive the algebraic formula for the incurred error of the machine.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2015
